draft.emotion: frustrated and tense, realizing something is ruined
notes: Imperfective; the perfective partner is сломать (used for single completed accidents, such as breaking an arm).
Use ломать for solid objects (sticks, furniture, toys, bones) or machines. For shattering glass or dishes, use разбивать.

senses.definition: To damage a solid object or machine so that it splits into pieces or stops working.
To fracture a bone in the body.

faults.quote: Зимой легко упасть и ломать руку.
faults.why: Wrong aspect: 'упасть' (pf) coordinated with 'ломать' (impf) is ungrammatical here; needs 'сломать'.
'Случайно стал ломать' (accidentally started breaking) is contradictory and unnatural.
